scheme_name: Startup Legal Facilitation – Virtual Courts for IP Disputes
overview: The Scheme of Action Research and Studies on Judicial Reforms is a Central Sector Scheme implemented by the Department of Justice, Ministry of Law & Justice, Government of India. It provides financial assistance in the form of grants to universities, law schools, research institutions, and other eligible entities for undertaking research projects on judicial reforms, access to justice, ease of doing business, and related themes. The scheme aims to generate evidence-based policy inputs for judicial reforms and strengthen the research ecosystem in the legal domain.
objectives: To promote action research and studies on judicial reforms
To generate policy inputs for improving access to justice
To support research on ease of doing business and commercial courts
To strengthen the research ecosystem in the legal and judicial domain
To facilitate evidence-based policy making in the Ministry of Law & Justice
eligibility: Universities, law schools, research institutions, NGOs, and individual researchers based in India are eligible to apply for grants under the Scheme of Action Research and Studies on Judicial Reforms, subject to the terms of the agreement and approval by the Department of Justice.
benefits: Financial support in the form of grants-in-aid for approved research projects, disbursed in instalments based on project milestones, with funding typically covering up to 100% of the sanctioned project cost.
financial_support: Grants are released in instalments (e.g., 20%, 40%, 30% or similar tranches) based on project progress and submission of utilization certificates, as per the terms of the agreement signed with the implementing agency, with payments made through e-payment to the beneficiary's account.
application_process: 1. Submit a research proposal under the Scheme of Action Research and Studies on Judicial Reforms to the Department of Justice. 2. Obtain approval of the proposal from the Competent Authority. 3. Sign an agreement with the Department of Justice outlining terms, budget, and timeline. 4. Receive instalments of the sanctioned grant upon completion of milestones and submission of required documents. 5. Submit utilization certificates and progress reports as per the agreement.
implementing_agency: Department of Justice, Ministry of Law & Justice, Government of India
caveats: Expenditure is debitable to Demand No. 65 under Major Head 2052-Secretariat General Services
Payments are subject to availability of funds and approval of IFD (Law) and Secretary (Justice)
Grantees must adhere to the timeline and terms specified in the approved proposal and agreement
